decisions.reason: The connector-specific sourceability impact is already fully represented by the existing message-53 MODIFY, which replaces the prior sourceability_requirement value with the fallback and recurring-availability constraints.
The source decision concerns availability of the proposed USB-C connector and does not change the I2C bus speed, pull-up resistance, cable length, or pull-up location.
The connector availability decision does not change the boost converter enable control, pull-down, powered loads, or sensor operating mode.
The source decision is specific to sourcing the proposed USB-C connector and does not alter any battery-protection behavior or protection mode.
